candidates.name: WERCO Building Specialties, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Website and BBB list toilet partitions and urinal screens as products; describes itself as a wholesale Division 10 distributor. No installation services stated.
candidates.reason: Commercial Division 10 distributor supplying toilet partitions to general contractors; installation not shown and Mississippi not named on its site (Baton Rouge is about 150 miles away). A supplier and buy-around risk more than an installer.
red_flags: About 150 miles away; Mississippi service not confirmed on own site

license.name: WERCO Building Specialties, Inc.
license.registry: Louisiana State Licensing Board for Contractors (LSLBC) contractor search (home state); Mississippi State Board of Contractors search (search.msboc.us) for the Jackson area
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. LSLBC name searches for 'WERCO', 'Werco', 'WERCO Building' and 'W E R C O' all returned 'No results found'. A Baton Rouge city search found no WERCO entry. LSLBC says only currently licensed or registered contractors appear in its results. The Mississippi Board of Contractors keyword search for 'Werco' returned 'No records were found matching your criteria' (http://search.msboc.us/ConsolidatedSearch.cfm); the same search does return matches for other names. The company site (https://wercospecs.com/) gives the name as Werco Building Specialties, Inc., based in Baton Rouge, LA. It calls the company a wholesale Division 10 distributor and lists toilet partitions as a product, but it does not mention installation. That would explain why it has no contractor license. The task gave no area rules for Jackson; if Jackson is Jackson, MS, the Mississippi board is the right registry.
